ATTENTION.description: Head counts and head grouping. Family-specific: an MHA, GQA, MLA or linear attention implementation registers separately under this kind.

COMPOSITE_STAGE1.dimension: all four structural dimensions at once
COMPOSITE_STAGE1.description: A single transformation from teacher to target that decides depth, residual width, FFN width and head structure jointly in one numerical pass. Exists so the incumbent recipe is a comparable member of the search space rather than an untested baseline outside it.

DEPTH.description: Which teacher blocks survive. Changes the block list only; every surviving block keeps its own widths.

RESIDUAL_WIDTH.description: The dimension of the residual stream every block reads and writes. Touches every stream-facing projection, the embedding and the final norm.

attention.weight_proxy_v0.objective: retained share of total head weight-proxy score
attention.weight_proxy_v0.target_validation: result num_attention_heads equals the target exactly and stays divisible by the unchanged KV head count
attention.weight_proxy_v0.description: Per-GQA-group query-head selection by ||W_q rows||_F * ||W_o columns||_F, with the preceding norm folded into W_q before scoring. KV heads, head_dim and grouping are preserved.

composite.stage1_sandwich_v0.target_validation: result spec must equal the target exactly in one step
composite.stage1_sandwich_v0.description: aadistill.init.sandwich.init_student verbatim: global activation-PCA stream projection, norm folding with sqrt(d_t/d_s) compensation, per-group query head selection, per-layer activation-importance FFN top-k, and either the positional depth map or an explicit kept-layer list. The recipe that produced qwen3_0p6b_init_v0 (86fbba78...) and e8_contribution_init_v1 (7a0694a5...).

depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1.target_validation: result num_hidden_layers equals the target exactly
depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1.description: Iterative greedy block removal minimizing forward KL(parent || parent-with-S-bypassed) over real prediction positions, aggregated as the unweighted mean over domains of the unweighted mean over each domain's sub-types. Ties break to the lower layer index. E8a's algorithm, re-run against the checkpoint it is handed rather than always against the teacher.

depth.positional_v0.objective: none (fixed positional heuristic; no measurement is taken)
depth.positional_v0.target_validation: result num_hidden_layers equals the target exactly
depth.positional_v0.description: Positional pairwise merge in a middle band: ~1/5 of the surviving 1:1 layers stay before the band, the rest after, so both the earliest and the latest blocks map 1:1. The incumbent map behind qwen3_0p6b_init_v0.

ffn.activation_importance_v0.objective: retained share of total activation importance
ffn.activation_importance_v0.target_validation: result intermediate_size equals the target exactly
ffn.activation_importance_v0.description: Per-block top-k intermediate neurons by E[|a|] * ||down column||, measured on the checkpoint being transformed. Rows of the gate and up projections and columns of the down projection are selected together, so the surviving neurons keep their own complete circuit.

width.global_pca_v0.objective: captured energy fraction of the residual second moment
width.global_pca_v0.target_validation: result hidden_size equals the target exactly
width.global_pca_v0.description: One global orthonormal projection from the trace-normalized average of the uncentered residual second moments, with the two stream end points (embedding output, post-final-norm) upweighted 9/8 because they are the worst-captured and are the interfaces the tied embedding reads.

beam_ranking_policy.description: Non-dominated sorting over original-teacher domain-balanced KL, critical-token KL and general NLL, with a total tie-break. NLL participates but cannot prune alone: a state that is worse on NLL and better on reasoning/domain fidelity is non-dominated and survives.

objectives.description: equal-domain mean forward KL from the original teacher
unweighted mean KL over declared critical-token classes
general-language NLL, a guardrail axis rather than the target

guardrails.name: structurally_valid
guardrails.description: the state reached MEASURED through materialize -> reload -> hash -> validate
